title: Makata AI Edge Lab: pre-registered experiments on on-device RAG for document QA
description: Code, pre-registered proof-of-concept experiments, and raw results for running retrieval-augmented document question-answering on 6 GB-class phones under memory and thermal limits. Includes the consolidated study paper (paper/). Each experiment commits its question, hypotheses and decision rule before the first run and publishes raw outputs; results are labelled MEASURED/OBSERVED/INFERRED.
notes: Code under Apache-2.0; write-ups and result data under CC BY 4.0. No model weights or datasets are redistributed. Replace the placeholder ORCID before the first Zenodo release, and add the arXiv DOI as a related_identifier (relation: isIdenticalTo) once the preprint is live.
